Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: see what is for sale
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A button on settlements on the world map lists what their traders sell before you travel there.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: random scenario
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A button on the scenario list picks a random scenario.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: fairer friendly fire
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Shots passing by allies of the shooter usually miss them, more often the better the shooter is. The intended target is not affected.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: turret no-fire zone
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: An area in the Orders menu where your turrets never shoot, to keep them away from your own airlock or hangar.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: quick save
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A key (F6 by default) saves the game right away, named after the colony and the date.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: sidearms
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Colonists carrying a melee weapon in their inventory swap to it when an enemy is adjacent, and back to the gun when the fight is over.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: rename buildings
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A button on your buildings gives them a name of your choice.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: export and import settings
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Buttons in the general settings save these settings to a file and load them back, to carry them to another save or computer.
